$comment: Single source of the tested browser stack. CI installs camoufox.tag, and playwrightCore.testedMinor records the playwright-core minor tested with it. camoufox.linuxX64Sha256 is the SHA-256 of that release's lin.x86_64.zip asset (its GitHub digest without the sha256: prefix); the installer refuses any other bytes, so move it with the tag. The values are the tested pair: change only the component being upgraded; scripts/browser-stack/manifest.mjs validates this file.
